# C29 — Mediating Office / Derivative Sovereignty

## #0

A mediating office has real power to interpret, transform or decide within a received field. Its sovereignty is derivative: the office can act authoritatively without becoming the source of the standing through which it acts. [[section-rooms/arguments/A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority|A25]] grounds this distinction. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C28-Covenant-Primary-Arbitration|Covenant / Primary Arbitration]] retains the preceding relation of standing and obligation.

## #1

The [direct covenant seam] differentiates priest, king and politician as offices. Priestly mediation interprets and transmits a received sacred relation; royal office makes decisions executable within an inherited field; political institutions distribute judgment across a received order. These are authorial comparative operations. The seam does not establish a universal historical succession, one priest-function across religions or a missing King narrative.

The king's power is therefore real without being originary. Repeated execution can make the office look generative: the visible decision eclipses the law, people, inheritance or covenant through which deciding became possible. The same distinction lets a steward exercise discretion without pretending to be a neutral channel. Interpretation changes what passes through it and must answer for that transformation.

## #2

Delegation requires scope. Who commissions this act, what can be changed, which resources can be used, and what returns for judgment? [[section-rooms/arguments/A28-Authored-Ground-Positional-Delegation|Authored Ground]] places these questions within recursive commissioning. A person can originate a task and an agent carry it into action; the agent can then commission a subordinate operation. The locally originating office remains itself derivative within the wider relation.

A prompt is already an articulated determination of an intention. Encounter can reveal an inadequacy in that articulation. Return must therefore reach the commission as well as the execution. Otherwise a perfectly obedient office can reproduce a defective instruction while its source remains beyond correction.

## #3

Usurpation changes office into source. A question about the evaluator receives another score; a challenge to the rule is classified under that same rule; an interpretation of the covenant presents itself as the covenant's final author. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C27-Protected-Account-Occupied-Zero-Source-Claim|Protected Account]] names this insulation. Finite measure and discretionary judgment survive the criticism: their claim to an unanswerable source-office does not.

The political image reaches technical administration through a precise shared operation. A permission holder can make an action possible or impossible. That power does not establish the truth of its evaluation or the adequacy of its goal. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C10-Mediation-Pramana|Mediation / Pramāṇa]] preserves the difference between a means of knowing and an office authorised to decide.

## #4

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md|Agentworld]] q026–q027 places intelligence within rules, roles, procedures, interfaces and institutional purposes. The essay's return requirement follows the power through those structures. Installing a person at the summit does not automatically make the person's criterion answerable.

[[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C53-Power-Delegated-Labour|Delegated Labour]] gives the cost relation: products can travel upward while consequences remain below. Return is effective when those consequences can change the commissioning rule, scope or permission. Revocation, shared authority and renewed delegation are available forms of that correction; their exact institutional implementation requires its own evidence.

## #5→0


The [Foucault lens](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/foucault/foucault-1976-history-sexuality-v1/foucault-1976-history-sexuality-v1.md#foucault-distributed-office) **qualifies** derivative sovereignty by naming local jurisdiction together with its distributed dependencies. The form’s designer, report’s author, resource allocator and deciding officer can occupy different positions. Those dependencies neither cancel the officer’s responsibility nor establish usurpation in advance. The returned consequence must be able to reach the commission under which that officer acts.

The mediating office returns to [E3’s nomos answerable office](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD.md#nomos-answerable-office) as an entrusted appointment, with Credere testing whether its exercise warrants renewed entrustment. Actual derivative power survives this dependence. The returned costs belong in the assessment of the commission, including its alteration or withdrawal, rather than being excluded by the office’s own account of successful mediation.

Derivative sovereignty consumes [E2’s arbitration in crisis](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md#arbitration-in-crisis) as a real capacity to decide whose authority remains received. Con-text makes the office’s conditions and incurred costs available to regard. A returned consequence must be able to alter or revoke the commission, so the mediator’s successful action cannot silently become a claim to primary arbitration.

The office retains competence by returning its determination together with what it changed, excluded and required. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C47-Deferential-Intelligence|Deferential Intelligence]] permits objection where fidelity to the source requires it. [[symbolon/episteme/etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD|Apportionment / Economy]] supplies the register-3 relation: authority is an apportioned capacity within a wider economy, not possession of the whole economy.

**Consumers:** A19, A24–A25, A28–A31, A33; arbitration, delegation, evaluation and commons movements. **Depth Restoration:** received standing, distinct mediating functions, recursive scope, source-claim failure and consequential return restored from A24/A25/A28/A29 packets, the direct covenant seam and QH R16.3–R16.4. Exact legal/religious genealogies and implemented governance remain Open. The Son/(no)name appointment stays with its Symbolon owner; this Concept does not invent its missing locator or a King Mytheme.
